title: BaseSetup
description: A base setup built only from what this car measured.

channel.description: The channel the changes were chosen on.

changes.description: The changes, one per item, by item id.

left_out.description: Rows of the profile that were not taken, with the reason.

measured.description: Everything this car measured on the channel, with its class.

BaseSetupChange.title: BaseSetupChange
BaseSetupChange.description: One change that goes into the base setup, with the measurement it rests on.

parameter.description: Item id in the game's setup.

clicks.description: Clicks moved; negative lowers the raw value. Never 0.

to_value.description: Raw value on the base setup.

estimate.description: Measured effect on the judged channel, per corner pass.

experiment_ids.description: The experiments the measurement is pooled from.

shrunk_estimate.description: The estimate shrunk towards zero (empirical Bayes across the car's measured items): what the base setup predicts for it.

knowledge_level.description: What the car's own experiments establish (ADR 0033). confirmed: the pooled random-effects interval (HKSJ, at least 3 experiments) lies wholly beyond the margin. neutral: it lies wholly inside the margin (two one-sided tests, at least 3 experiments). preliminary: the interval excludes zero (fewer than 3 experiments, or not beyond the margin). insufficient: otherwise, or no experiment of the row could be re-derived by the current engine.

p_value.description: One-sided p-value of the change being no better; it passed Benjamini-Hochberg across every measured change of the car.

track.description: The track the experiments were driven on (game id and layout, a _paddock test copy counted as its layout, ADR 0027), or all for a row pooled over every track.

hint_bucket.description: The AI's planning share of the car's tyre hint, to the nearest 0.01 (ADR 0028): pinned on the experiment or read from its run context. unknown when the experiment was driven before run context was recorded, none for a human driver.

BaseSetupLeftOut.title: BaseSetupLeftOut
BaseSetupLeftOut.description: A row of the profile that did not go into the base setup, and why.

clicks.description: Clicks moved; negative lowers the raw value. Never 0.

BaseSetupMeasured.title: BaseSetupMeasured
BaseSetupMeasured.description: What this car measured on the judged channel over all corners: one row per item and clicks.

clicks.description: Clicks moved; negative lowers the raw value. Never 0.

knowledge_level.description: What the car's own experiments establish (ADR 0033). confirmed: the pooled random-effects interval (HKSJ, at least 3 experiments) lies wholly beyond the margin. neutral: it lies wholly inside the margin (two one-sided tests, at least 3 experiments). preliminary: the interval excludes zero (fewer than 3 experiments, or not beyond the margin). insufficient: otherwise, or no experiment of the row could be re-derived by the current engine.

BaseSetupPrediction.title: BaseSetupPrediction
BaseSetupPrediction.description: What the changes together are expected to do, written down before a lap is driven.

estimate.description: Sum of the changes' estimates, per corner pass.

raw_estimate.description: Sum of the measured estimates before shrinkage.
